searchText: what do you have in mind for EL's experimenting with historical block data? Are you thinking about execution clients relying on portal network for historical queries? and/or using portal network to sync the chain? Initially, I think fetching historical blocks that have been pruned. We would be very happy to collaborate on sync as well but current structure doesn't implement any kind of bulk retrieval so not very conducive to supporting sync given the large number of queries, but also doesn't rule out using it for sync But really, I'd like to know how you'd like to use it, what you're ideal use case would look like We have the data and can expose it in different ways

excerpts.author: pipermerriam
excerpts.content:
Initially, I think fetching historical blocks that have been pruned.

We would be very happy to collaborate on sync as well but current structure doesn't implement any kind of bulk retrieval so not very conducive to supporting sync given the large number of queries, but also doesn't rule out using it for sync
